objective: Fix the live 0.6.64 canary gap where activation publishes route_pending before the app-server mux descriptor becomes ready and otherwise waits for the 4-minute renewal. Immediately re-run the existing route convergence after the existing ensureStarted promise resolves.

evidence.source_graph_evidence: Source Graph build_revision=python_ast.v1 returned 96 Python-only hits with zero JavaScript coverage. Bounded exact-target reads limited to vscode-extension/extension.js and the B1017 test per coordinator authorization.

vscode-extension/extension.js.change: In activate(), after getMcpClient().ensureStarted() resolves successfully, immediately call refreshCoordinatorRouteOwnership(activeRepoIdentity) to publish capability_state=available from a ready mux descriptor instead of waiting for the 4-minute renewal tick.
vscode-extension/extension.js.preserved: route_pending pre-start (fail-closed), catch handler for failures, renewal timing, split-brain protection, callback architecture, dispatcher layers

B1017.4: Ambiguous ownership (two instances) remains route_pending

B1017.6: Renewal-tick path converges to available on the same function
